versions.content: Pri vate keys for NIST and Brainpool ECC curves are provided with their X and Y coordinates and an additional scalar: ECC Private Key = Point X | Point Y | Scalar. The points and the scalar are stored in little endian format. Example: Brainpool curve P(25 6) = X(32) | Y(32) | SCALAR(32)
